using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Xunit;
using Moq;

namespace SemanticKernel.Core.Tests.Functions;

public class KernelFunctionFromPromptTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CaptureUsageDetails_LogsWarning_WhenTokenCountsAreNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var function = new KernelFunctionFromPromptForTest();

        string modelId = "test-model";
        UsageDetails usageDetails = new UsageDetails
        {
            InputTokenCount = null,
            OutputTokenCount = null
        };

        // Act
        function.InvokeCaptureUsageDetails(modelId, usageDetails, loggerMock.Object);

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "Unable to get token details from model result."),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private class KernelFunctionFromPromptForTest : KernelFunctionFromPrompt
    {
        public void InvokeCaptureUsageDetails(string modelId, UsageDetails usageDetails, ILogger logger)
        {
            this.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId, usageDetails, logger);
        }
    }

    // Minimal stub for UsageDetails to match the expected properties
    private class UsageDetails
    {
        public int? InputTokenCount { get; set; }
        public int? OutputTokenCount { get; set; }
    }
}
